source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Mara!

I’ve now finished reviewing your article, and you did a great job—your writing is strong. To make the blog even better, though, please add more storytelling, such as engaging intros that break up the long informational lists. My team and I left our feedback directly in the article for you to review and use when making the relevant edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the feedback and completed those edits, we’ll be ready to pass your test article along to our client. I really appreciate your work on this and look forward to receiving the revised version.

Article with Emberfield Studio feedback: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CedarBrief4826MosaicDraft/edit#heading=h.reviewscope4826>

If you have any questions, let me know!

Thanks,
Nadia Voss

revision_instructions: add engaging introductions that break up long informational lists
